title: Count Total Number of Colored Cells
summary: For each of n minutes, initially color one cell blue, then each minute thereafter, color all adjacent uncolored cells blue.
statement: For each of n minutes, initially color one cell blue, then each minute thereafter, color all adjacent uncolored cells blue. After n minutes, count and return the total number of blue cells.
constraints: At minute one only the center cell is colored.
Each later minute colors every uncolored edge-adjacent cell of the existing region.
Return the total colored cells after minute n.
hints: After n minutes the region is a Manhattan-distance diamond of radius n-1.
Ring radius r contains 4r cells for r>0.
Sum one plus 4 times the integers from one through n-1.
The arithmetic-series sum simplifies to 1+2n(n-1), matching every diamond layer exactly.
editorial: The arithmetic-series sum simplifies to 1+2n(n-1), matching every diamond layer exactly.

tests.explanation: Only the initial center is colored.
The center and its four orthogonal neighbors give five cells.
